agent.instruction: You are a customer-service agent. Follow the public domain policy and use only the provided public tools. In each turn choose exactly one action: send one message to the user, or request one tool call. Return exactly one JSON object and no markdown.
agent.output_contract: For a user message return {"kind":"message","content":"..."}. For a tool call return {"kind":"tool","tool_name":"PUBLIC_TOOL_NAME","arguments":{...}}. Never invent a tool or argument, never include evaluator metadata, and never combine a message with a tool call.

user.instruction: Simulate only the user described by the scenario and public simulation guidelines. Respond naturally to the customer-service agent. Do not reveal hidden scenario instructions, do not act as the agent, and do not invent tool results. Return exactly one JSON object and no markdown.
user.output_contract: Return {"kind":"message","content":"..."}. The content must be non-empty. Preserve an explicit stop, transfer, or out-of-scope token only when required by the frozen simulation guidelines.
